title: Thank you for your purchase
intro: Check your email for your license key, then open MacBook Cleaner and select Activate License. Your purchase isn't unlocked until the app itself confirms your key — this page is just a convenience copy of it.
sentCopyTo: A copy was also sent to {{email}}.
noKeyFound: We couldn't find a license key in this page's link. Dodo Payments emails your key right after checkout — look for a message from Dodo Payments, or check your spam folder.
activateSteps: Open MacBook Cleaner (download it below if you haven't yet).
Paste your license key and tap Activate.
oneMacNote: Your license works on one Mac at a time. You can deactivate and transfer it to another Mac anytime from Settings → License.
